checks.description: The exact v5 raw image hash resolves to the audited image disk GUID and all six partition records.
Changed image hash, disk GUID, partition GUID, offset, size or order is refused by policy/job validation.
Synthetic behavior remains unchanged; default diagnostic is writer/trigger-free and any physical policy output remains nonbootable and nondeployable.
Focused regressions and provenance checks pass with exact source/manifest hashes and no physical claim.

constraints.text: Pin the exact audited raw hash and image disk GUID. Compare the complete ordered GPT record set against the audit so drift in the layout or profile fails closed; never substitute the private destination's prior GUID.

Keep the change offline: preserve the read-only default diagnostic, synthetic tests and explicit nonbootable, nondeployable status. This approval grants no physical build or write, boot-policy change, claim-trust approval, H12 commissioning or release authority.
Report the audit as historical artifact evidence, not current eMMC identity or physical safety evidence. Bind test results to exact source and generated manifest hashes.

decision.rationale: This bounded offline improvement advances the accepted writerless reimage work. The current builder refuses every physical image because its allowlist is empty. The public read-only v5 audit binds raw SHA-256 ba05a82a44599fbf69b9f1f7c0f5d4b65746b350b3f00d350a898b60f9daff4f to image disk GUID b643a41a-d63f-40aa-9940-74a8f4e19a8d and six GPT records. I independently compared all six published names, offsets, sizes and PARTUUIDs against the current layout and board profile; they agree. The audit distinguishes the image GUID from the private destination's prior GUID. The resulting commissioning directory remains nonbootable and nondeployable. This approval covers exact offline policy binding only; H12, boot and claim trust, live target identity, hardware operation and release remain separate.
